description: This Java source file defines an immutable class `NullFeatureDefinition` that implements the `FeatureDefinition` interface, representing a null or empty feature definition within the Eclipse Ditto model concerning 'things'. It includes methods for accessing identifiers, size, JSON serialization, and equality, along with an inner class `NullIdentifier` implementing `DefinitionIdentifier` that provides default or empty identifier values.

classes.name: NullFeatureDefinition
classes.description: Immutable implementation of FeatureDefinition representing a null feature, providing methods to retrieve identifiers, size, JSON representation, and equality checks.

classes.name: NullFeatureDefinition.NullIdentifier
classes.description: A singleton inner class implementing DefinitionIdentifier with empty or default values, representing a null identifier.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of NullFeatureDefinition, ensuring only one instance exists.

methods.name: getFirstIdentifier
methods.description: Returns a default NullIdentifier indicating no actual identifier.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns 0, indicating the feature definition contains no elements.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Returns an empty Stream of DefinitionIdentifier, representing no contained identifiers.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over an empty list, representing no elements.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Returns a JsonArray representing null, obtained from JsonFactory.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on the wrapped JsonArray.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object, considering the wrapped JsonArray.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the class including the wrapped JsonArray.
